WITH CategoryDemand AS (
    SELECT 
        Categories.CategoryID,

        AVG(Products.UnitsInStock) AS AvgUnitsInStock
    FROM order_details
    JOIN Products ON order_details.ProductID = Products.ProductID
    JOIN Categories ON Products.CategoryID = Categories.CategoryID
    GROUP BY Categories.CategoryID
),
HighDemandCategories AS (
    SELECT CategoryID
    FROM CategoryDemand
    WHERE TotalQuantitySold > (SELECT AVG(TotalQuantitySold) FROM CategoryDemand)
)
SELECT 
    AVG(CategoryDemand.TotalQuantitySold / CategoryDemand.AvgUnitsInStock) AS AvgInventoryTurnoverRate
FROM CategoryDemand
WHERE CategoryDemand.CategoryID IN (SELECT CategoryID FROM HighDemandCategories);

WITH AnnualOrders AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(strftime('%Y', OrderDate) AS INTEGER) AS Year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT OrderID) AS TotalOrders
    FROM Orders
    GROUP BY Year
),
OrderGrowth AS (
    SELECT
        Year,
        TotalOrders,
        LAG(TotalOrders) OVER (ORDER BY Year) AS PreviousYearOrders
    FROM AnnualOrders
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        ((TotalOrders - PreviousYearOrders) * 100.0 / PreviousYearOrders),
        2
    ) AS GrowthRate
FROM OrderGrowth
WHERE PreviousYearOrders IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY Year DESC
